launch_authorization: Implemented and unit-tested (torch-free part) by Claude only; nothing prepared, fitted or evaluated by the author. Requires Codex review, the D0 preparation below and a passed --preflight-only.
design_source: v28 rules.next_round (start from the validation-chosen TSMixer_last10, add at most one information group, confirm on 2022 under a new frozen protocol); Claude diagnosis of the opened v28 test year 2021 (700 low-anchor abnormal windows: TSMixer_last10 MAE 109 kW vs PersistenceLast10 26 kW; farm-common error share 72-82%); user decisions 2026-10-26 (operating-state group with all-window training; NWP feasibility assessed separately; splits rolled forward)
scope: one information group (observable operating state) on the v28-chosen TSMixer_last10, as a 2x2 factorial with the training cohort, plus a fixed rule-based comparator; no Wiki; no novelty claim
questions: Q1 information: with the same all-window training, do the observed operating-state channels (available capacity, stopped-tick share) improve TSMixer_last10 on the deployment cohort?
Q2 training cohort: with the state channels, does training on all windows instead of normal-operation windows help on the deployment cohort?
Q3 naive: does the validation-chosen configuration beat the last-10-minute Persistence on the new year 2022?
Q4 rule: does the learned state model beat a fixed ex-ante rule that falls back to Persistence when the turbine is at near-zero power at issue?
novelty_claim: none; TSMixer-basic and Persistence are published baselines; the state channels are SCADA observations

data.source: Zenodo 16807551, Kelmarsh six Senvion MM92, CC BY 4.0

v28_registered_preparation.use: identity reference only: every 2016-2021 row of the v29 preparation must equal this registered CSV, and the power curves must be identical

v29_preparation.raw_reuse: hard-link or copy the MD5-verified 2016-2021 archives and Kelmarsh_WT_static.csv from the v28 raw directory into datasets/wind_public_v29/resampled_hourly_scada/kelmarsh_multiyear/raw first; the preparation re-verifies size and official MD5 of every archive and downloads only 2022
v29_preparation.rule: prepared only after this protocol is frozen; 2023-2024 are never prepared or read in v29
v29_preparation.label_audit: the read-only scripts/audit_kelmarsh_multiyear_preparation.py may read 2022 raw labels to prove label preservation; no metric, model, threshold or selection may use 2022 before the S1 freeze

data.common_window_rule: ONE series is built with the union of all channels; every arm uses exactly these windows (finite history in all eleven channels, finite four power targets); the last10 arms only drop the two state channels

state_group.definition: hourly mean of the provider's available capacity divided by rated power; share of the six 10-minute ticks with wind >= 5 m/s and power <= 1% rated (utils/kelmarsh_enrichment.RULES)
state_group.relation_to_cohorts: the same tick states define the stopped/derated flags of the normal cohort, but only for the target hours; inputs use history hours only

data.scaler: provider rule: mean/std of all training-year rows (ddof 0, NaN ignored); not refitted per cohort

cohorts.normal: all four target hours are normal-operation hours (ex-post, uses the target period's operating state; conditional accuracy only)
cohorts.all: every common window with original labels (deployment accuracy)
cohorts.primary_reason: the state group targets stopped and derated turbines, which the normal cohort excludes by construction; user decision 2026-10-26 to train the state group on all windows
cohorts.training_cohort_policy: each TSMixer arm trains on its declared cohort of the train years; every arm selects its epoch on the ALL windows of the validation year
cohorts.reporting: every metric table reports BOTH test cohorts; all is primary in v29, normal is mandatory secondary; cohort sizes and normal share are reported

Guard_last10_normal.rule: per seed: if the last observed 10-minute power at issue is below threshold_frac_rated x rated power, forecast PersistenceLast10 for all four leads; otherwise the base arm's forecast
Guard_last10_normal.threshold_source: chosen once using the opened 2021 v28 test year, which is reused as v29 development/validation data; frozen before any 2022 preparation or evaluation, with no subsequent threshold search

training.selection_metric: validation original-scale MAE on the validation-year ALL cohort for every arm
training.tie_policy: strictly lower MAE updates; ties keep the earlier epoch
training.same_recipe_as: v28 TSMixer_last10 (scripts/train_kelmarsh_multiyear_benchmark.fit_config, unchanged) except the uniform ALL selection cohort

stages.name: data identity
stages.checks: v29 preparation metadata (schema 2, years 2016-2022, curve years 2016-2019, CSV hash); registered v28 CSV and metadata hashes; every 2016-2021 row equal to the registered v28 CSV; identical power curves; common-window counts without the test year

stages.name: selection freeze
stages.freeze: every selected state hash and validation metric, the Guard validation metrics recomputed from the registered base validation predictions, and the validation-chosen configuration, written before any test window is instantiated

stages.name: single test evaluation of every arm on both cohorts
post-test manifest
stages.content: post_test_manifest.json: train/validation/test all+normal window counts from the post-freeze series audit, consistency with the registered test cohort, hashes of the pre-test data_manifest.json, the selection freeze, the test cohort and every test prediction; the pre-test data_manifest.json stays an unmodified pre-test snapshot

validation_choice: among the four TSMixer arms and Guard_last10_normal: lowest seed-mean validation ALL MAE (ties: fewer parameters, the Guard counting its base arm's parameters; then protocol order)

statistics.cohort: computed separately on test all and test normal
statistics.seed_handling: losses averaged over the 3 seeds on identical windows
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm over the C1-C6 MAE Newey-West p-values within each cohort; raw p retained
statistics.rmse: issue-time block bootstrap of squared-error sums; separate from the MAE CI

issue_state_regimes.stopped_at_issue: stopped_frac of the last input hour > 0
issue_state_regimes.derated_at_issue: available_capacity_frac of the last input hour < 0.98

diagnostics.ensemble: 3-seed mean forecast of the validation-chosen arm (descriptive deployment estimate, no rule)
diagnostics.use: descriptive only; ex-ante regimes defined by issue-time observations; no decision rule

rules.state_information_supported: C1 on test all: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0, Holm p <= 0.05 and RMSE gain > 0, AND C1 on test normal: MAE gain CI95 lower > -non_inferiority_margin_kw; supports the wider input variant, not pure information attribution at equal parameter count
rules.all_window_training_supported: C3 on test all: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0, Holm p <= 0.05 and RMSE gain > 0, AND C3 on test normal: MAE gain CI95 lower > -non_inferiority_margin_kw
rules.learned_state_beats_rule: C6 on test all: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0 and Holm p <= 0.05
rules.beats_naive: C5 on test all AND test normal: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0 and Holm p <= 0.05
rules.descriptive_only: C2, C4, the ensemble and the regime table are reported without decision rules
rules.attribution_limits: C1/C2 change input width and parameter count (4262 -> 4906). C3/C4 change the training windows, not the inputs. The Guard threshold was fixed from the opened 2021 test year of v28 and is not an independent discovery. No Wiki contribution or causal attribution is established by these contrasts.
rules.next_round: the next protocol starts from the validation-chosen configuration of v29; a numerical-weather-prediction group is considered only with Codex's feasibility report (issue-time-available historical forecasts, no reanalysis as a forecast), adds at most one information group and confirms on 2023 prepared under its own frozen protocol; 2022 is not reused as a confirmation year; 2024 stays sealed
rules.no_post_hoc: no arm, seed, epoch, threshold, cohort rule or channel may be chosen from 2022 results

forbidden: test access before the S1 freeze
modifying v25-v28 files or the registered v28 preparation
